name: Belgorod Open 2017

venue.name: [Belgorod University of Cooperation, Economy and Law](http://www.bukep.ru)

information: All 18 events! Registration will be closed at midnight on October, 4 or when we reach 200 competitors. Spectators are welcome and do not need to register or pay. Registration fee: * **FREE** for students of Belgorod University of Cooperation, Economy and Law; * **100 RUB**(~2 USD) for any one event (for ex. Rubik's Cube only); * **200 RUB** (~4 USD) for equal or less than 10 events; * **+10 RUB** for earch event more 10; (for ex. 280 RUB for 18 events); If you do not see your name on the compeitors table after 48 hours of registering, please [contact us](mailto:ruslan.chaika@mail.ru,robota.av@gmail.com) to resolve the issue. Visit the competition [website](https://vk.com/belgorodopen2017) for more details.
